title: AANCER skill (pack item kind skill, schemaVersion 1)
description: The spec of a skill item: a named block of instructions that changes how the AI answers in chat and in agents. At install the triggers are appended to the description as " Use when: a; b; c." and the combined text must stay at or under 1000 characters.

id.description: Use the same value as the item id.

connectors.description: Preferred connectors. A hint only; grants no access.
